criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Image-conditioned base workflow is documented; exact-product identity is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No AIVP or independent output benchmark.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Self-contained weights/tokenizer are documented, but the compatible LocalLab runtime is not public.

criteria.name: Control & consistency
criteria.notes: Prompt and fixed three-step schedule are documented; three-run consistency is unknown.

criteria.name: Speed & reliability
criteria.notes: Author reports two complete M2 Max timings; no repeated-run failure data.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: No API fee and local execution documented; hardware/electricity cost per usable output unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Repository declares Apache-2.0; production must still confirm upstream/input/output rights.

criteria.name: Automation & integration
criteria.notes: Machine-readable local package exists; public stock loader is explicitly incompatible with this encoder.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Ungated download is geographically accessible; requires capable Apple Silicon.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Potential local creator workflow, but no affiliate programme and no recommendation before testing.

analysis: A meaningful Apple-Silicon memory reduction is documented, but no AIVP render, public compatible runtime, product-fidelity result or reliability sample exists.
confidence_notes: Primary model documentation and author measurements only; no hands-on AIVP evidence.
